Scanned insert, sheet 10 — cell 3

Cotnactor K404 on rai1 3 — repalcement for the older unit. Ths page was inserted
as a photocopy and its text layer is unreliable.
summary: A photocopied insert whose text layer came out garbled; it names one contactor.
note: §5.7 — `text_trust: untrusted` counts as unsearchable for `lookup`, so `K404` is not a verified hit even though the phrase is in the text. It is still disclosed through `unverified_hits`.
